name.it: Risposte alle opposizioni del Senato di Venezia
name.en-US: Replies in the Venetian Interdict Controversy
name.pt-BR: Respostas na questão do Interdito de Veneza

description.it: Gli scritti italiani di Bellarmino durante l'Interdetto di Venezia (1606): risposte ai sette teologi della Repubblica e ad altri opuscoli. Testo dell'edizione Vivès (1870-74), tomo VIII, da scansione OCR.
description.en-US: Bellarmine's Italian writings during the Venetian Interdict (1606): replies to the Republic's theologians and other pamphlets. Italian only: the Vivès edition (1870-74), volume 8, from an OCR scan.
description.pt-BR: Os escritos italianos de Belarmino durante o Interdito de Veneza (1606).

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 8 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
